UCLA Anderson job-market pages cover all areas; DOTM candidates are Aparupa Das Gupta (2013-14, placement blank), Boyoun Choi and Wei Zhang (2014-15, placements blank); 2013-14 placements are given for the other areas. UGA Terry page is management (OB/strategy) candidates only, no placements. Iowa MIE page lists industrial-engineering dissertation titles without authors, so it was not counted as a list. Glasgow page is a repository subject category (Asian history), out of scope. Institutions by host kept for all pages.
